parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The time when the client initiated the request. The format is **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of resources to return. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 100. The number of returned results may be less than the specified value but never exceeds it.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The token used to retrieve more results. You do not need to provide this parameter for the first query. The token for subsequent queries is obtained from the returned results.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: The prefix that the names of returned resources must start with.

parameters.name: startKey
parameters.description: Specifies that the results are returned in alphabetical order starting from the value of startKey (inclusive).
